+"""Muse Spark decode MoE finalize fused with the TP4 all-reduce (MI355X, ``SGLANG_MUSE_FINALIZE_AR_PUSH``).
+
+``finalize_allreduce.hip`` replaces the FlyDSL finalize + aiter two-stage all-reduce pair of the compact A4
+target-verify MoE with one launch; see its header for the protocol. The code object is built at first use with
+``hipcc --genco`` and launched through ``hipModuleLaunchKernel``, so it is graph-capturable without a torch
+extension. Construction is collective over the TP CPU group and must happen outside graph capture.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ctypes
+import logging
+import os
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_SRC = os.path.join(
+    os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "finalize_allreduce.hip"
+)
+_NR = 4
+_HIDDEN = 4096
+_TOPK = 8
+_ROW_BYTES = _HIDDEN * 2
+_IPC_LAZY_ENABLE_PEER_ACCESS = 0x1
+
+
+class _IpcHandle(ctypes.Structure):
+    _fields_ = [("reserved", ctypes.c_char * 64)]
+
+
+class _Args(ctypes.Structure):
+    _fields_ = [
+        ("y", ctypes.c_void_p),
+        ("gamma", ctypes.c_void_p),
+        ("scores", ctypes.c_void_p),
+        ("ids", ctypes.c_void_p),
+        ("out", ctypes.c_void_p),
+        ("peers", ctypes.c_void_p * _NR),
+        ("row_state", ctypes.c_void_p),
+        ("local_start", ctypes.c_int32),
+        ("num_local", ctypes.c_int32),
+        ("eps", ctypes.c_float),
+        ("gain", ctypes.c_float),
+        ("rank", ctypes.c_int32),
+        ("rows", ctypes.c_int32),
+        ("max_rows", ctypes.c_uint32),
+        ("pad", ctypes.c_uint32),
+    ]
+
+
+class _FillArgs(ctypes.Structure):
+    _fields_ = [("p", ctypes.c_void_p), ("n16", ctypes.c_uint64)]
+
+
+assert ctypes.sizeof(_Args) == 112 and ctypes.sizeof(_FillArgs) == 16
+
+_hip = None
+
+
+def _hip_lib():
+    global _hip
+    if _hip is None:
+        h = ctypes.CDLL("libamdhip64.so")
+        h.hipModuleLoad.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
+        h.hipModuleGetFunction.argtypes = [
+            ctypes.c_void_p,
+            ctypes.c_void_p,
+            ctypes.c_char_p,
+        ]
+        h.hipModuleLaunchKernel.argtypes = (
+            [ctypes.c_void_p] + [ctypes.c_uint] * 7 + [ctypes.c_void_p] * 3
+        )
+        h.hipMalloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
+        h.hipFree.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
+        h.hipIpcGetMemHandle.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
+        h.hipIpcOpenMemHandle.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, _IpcHandle, ctypes.c_uint]
+        h.hipGetErrorString.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
+        _hip = h
+    return _hip
+
+
+def _check(rc: int, what: str) -> None:
+    if rc != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"finalize_allreduce: {what} failed: {rc} ({_hip_lib().hipGetErrorString(rc).decode()})"
+        )
+
+
+def _build(arch: str, sqrt: str) -> str:
+    out_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="sglang_muse_finalize_ar_")
+    co = os.path.join(out_dir, "finalize_allreduce.co")
+    hipcc = os.path.join(os.environ.get("ROCM_PATH", "/opt/rocm"), "bin", "hipcc")
+    # No FMA contraction: the FlyDSL finalize rounds every multiply and add separately.
+    cmd = [hipcc, "--genco", f"--offload-arch={arch}", "-O3", "-ffp-contract=off",
+           f"-DMUSE_SQRT={sqrt}", "-o", co, _SRC]  # fmt: skip
+    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    return co
+
+
+class _Kernel:
+    def __init__(self, module, name: str):
+        self.fn = ctypes.c_void_p()
+        _check(
+            _hip_lib().hipModuleGetFunction(
+                ctypes.byref(self.fn), module, name.encode()
+            ),
+            name,
+        )
+
+    def launch(self, grid: int, args, stream: int) -> None:
+        size = ctypes.c_size_t(ctypes.sizeof(args))
+        extra = (ctypes.c_void_p * 5)(
+            1, ctypes.addressof(args), 2, ctypes.addressof(size), 3
+        )  # HIP_LAUNCH_PARAM_BUFFER_POINTER / _SIZE / _END
+        _check(
+            _hip_lib().hipModuleLaunchKernel(
+                self.fn,
+                grid,
+                1,
+                1,
+                256,
+                1,
+                1,
+                0,
+                ctypes.c_void_p(stream),
+                None,
+                ctypes.cast(extra, ctypes.c_void_p),
+            ),
+            "hipModuleLaunchKernel",
+        )
+
+
+class MuseFinalizeAllreduce:
+    """Per-process TP4 finalize + all-reduce; every rank must issue the same sequence of calls."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        cpu_group,
+        device: torch.device,
+        max_rows: int = 512,
+        sqrt: str = "__builtin_amdgcn_sqrtf",
+    ):
+        self.rank = dist.get_rank(group=cpu_group)
+        if dist.get_world_size(group=cpu_group) != _NR:
+            raise ValueError("finalize_allreduce supports TP4 only")
+        self.device = device
+        self.max_rows = int(max_rows)
+        h = _hip_lib()
+        with torch.cuda.device(device):
+            arch = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).gcnArchName.split(":")[0]
+            co = _build(arch, sqrt)
+            module = ctypes.c_void_p()
+            try:
+                _check(
+                    h.hipModuleLoad(ctypes.byref(module), co.encode()), "hipModuleLoad"
+                )
+            finally:
+                shutil.rmtree(os.path.dirname(co), ignore_errors=True)
+            self._module = module
+            self._k = _Kernel(module, "muse_finalize_allreduce_tp4")
+            fill = _Kernel(module, "muse_finalize_allreduce_fill")
+            nbytes = 3 * (_NR + 1) * self.max_rows * _ROW_BYTES
+            ptr = ctypes.c_void_p()
+            _check(h.hipMalloc(ctypes.byref(ptr), nbytes), "hipMalloc")
+            handle = _IpcHandle()
+            _check(
+                h.hipIpcGetMemHandle(ctypes.byref(handle), ptr), "hipIpcGetMemHandle"
+            )
+            handles = [None] * _NR
+            dist.all_gather_object(
+                handles, ctypes.string_at(ctypes.addressof(handle), 64), group=cpu_group
+            )
+            self._peers = (ctypes.c_void_p * _NR)()
+            for i, raw in enumerate(handles):
+                if i == self.rank:
+                    self._peers[i] = ptr.value
+                    continue
+                peer, ph = ctypes.c_void_p(), _IpcHandle()
+                ctypes.memmove(ctypes.addressof(ph), raw, 64)
+                _check(
+                    h.hipIpcOpenMemHandle(
+                        ctypes.byref(peer), ph, _IPC_LAZY_ENABLE_PEER_ACCESS
+                    ),
+                    "hipIpcOpenMemHandle",
+                )
+                self._peers[i] = peer.value
+            self.row_state = torch.tensor(
+                [0, -1], dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+            ).repeat(self.max_rows)
+            fill.launch(
+                1024,
+                _FillArgs(ptr.value, nbytes // 16),
+                torch.cuda.current_stream(device).cuda_stream,
+            )
+            torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
+        dist.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+
+    def applies(self, rows: int) -> bool:
+        return 0 < rows <= self.max_rows and rows % _NR == 0
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        y,
+        gamma,
+        scores,
+        ids,
+        local_start: int,
+        num_local: int,
+        eps: float,
+        gain: float,
+    ):
+        """bf16 [M, 4096]: the all-reduced finalize of per-slot rows ``y`` [M * 8, 4096] (FlyDSL finalize numerics)."""
+        m = ids.shape[0]
+        assert (
+            self.applies(m)
+            and ids.shape == (m, _TOPK)
+            and y.shape == (m * _TOPK, _HIDDEN)
+        )
+        assert (
+            y.dtype == gamma.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and scores.dtype == torch.float32
+            and ids.dtype == torch.int32
+        )
+        assert (
+            y.is_contiguous()
+            and scores.is_contiguous()
+            and ids.is_contiguous()
+            and gamma.is_contiguous()
+        )
+        out = torch.empty((m, _HIDDEN), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=y.device)
+        args = _Args(
+            y.data_ptr(), gamma.data_ptr(), scores.data_ptr(), ids.data_ptr(), out.data_ptr(),
+            self._peers, self.row_state.data_ptr(), int(local_start), int(num_local), float(eps), float(gain),
+            self.rank, m, self.max_rows, 0,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+        self._k.launch(m, args, torch.cuda.current_stream(y.device).cuda_stream)
+        return out
+
+
+_instance: MuseFinalizeAllreduce | None = None
+
+
+def ensure_finalize_allreduce(cpu_group, device: torch.device) -> MuseFinalizeAllreduce:
+    """The process-wide instance, built on first use (collective; call outside graph capture)."""
+    global _instance
+    if _instance is None:
+        _instance = MuseFinalizeAllreduce(cpu_group, device)
+        logger.info(
+            "Muse fused finalize + TP4 all-reduce enabled (rank %d)", _instance.rank
+        )
+    return _instance
+
+
+def run_compact_a4_allreduce(
+    op: MuseFinalizeAllreduce,
+    x,
+    scores,
+    ids,
+    experts,
+    local_start,
+    norm_weight,
+    eps,
+    gain,
+    quantized=None,
+):
+    """Compact A4 experts of this rank, then the fused finalize + TP all-reduce: the reduced MoE output."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.mxfp4_compact_a4_moe import compact_a4_experts
+    from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark.mxfp4_moe import _compact_a4_operands
+
+    y = compact_a4_experts(
+        x, ids, *_compact_a4_operands(experts), local_start=local_start,
+        shuffled=experts.native_dropped, quantized=quantized,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    return op(
+        y, norm_weight, scores, ids, local_start, experts.num_local_experts, eps, gain
+    )

+"""Packed NVFP4 routed experts for Muse Spark, on public SGLang + FlashInfer.
+
+Muse applies an RMSNorm to each expert's output *before* the top-k weighted sum.
+The fused TRT-LLM MoE kernel folds GEMM2 and that combine together, so the norm
+has nowhere to go. We therefore ask the kernel for its un-combined output
+(``do_finalize=False``) and run a CuTeDSL unpermute -> norm -> weighted-sum
+implementation built on public CUDA Python and CUTLASS APIs.
+
+Weight allocation and scale processing come from the public ModelOpt quant
+method, with a corrected TRT-LLM weight aligner substituted before
+processing; the GEMMs come from public FlashInfer. The Torch finalize below
+remains as the no-post-norm fallback and reference.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.base import MoeRunnerConfig
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
+from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark.fused_post_expert_norm_weighted_sum_trtllm import (
+    FusedPostExpertNormWeightedSumTRTLLM,
+)
+from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark.nvfp4_moe import (
+    MuseSparkNvFp4FusedMoEMethod,
+)
+
+# 1 / (fp8_e4m3_max * 6)
+_NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_SCALE_INV = 1.0 / (448.0 * 6.0)
+
+
+def _native_finalize_enabled() -> bool:
+    return os.environ.get("MUSE_SPARK_NVFP4_NATIVE_FINALIZE", "0") == "1"
+
+
+class _DirectDispatcher:
+    """Stand-in for a FusedMoE token dispatcher.
+
+    ``process_weights_after_loading`` hands the activation scales to
+    ``layer.dispatcher`` so an all-to-all backend can quantize before dispatch.
+    We invoke the kernel directly on a single node, so there is nothing to
+    configure -- the scales are read straight off the layer in ``forward``.
+    """
+
+    local_expert_mapping = None
+
+    def set_quant_config(self, quant_config: dict) -> None:
+        self.quant_config = quant_config
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xFp4Experts(nn.Module):
+    """Routed experts held as packed NVFP4 and executed by the TRT-LLM kernel.
+
+    Weight *preparation* is delegated to the public ModelOpt method with the
+    corrected aligner; only the forward is hand-written, because of
+    the post-expert norm.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        num_experts: int,
+        num_local_experts: int,
+        local_expert_offset: int,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        intermediate_size: int,
+        top_k: int,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig,
+        params_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        # create_weights sizes the activation scales from ``num_experts``, so it
+        # must be the LOCAL count; the kernel separately wants the global count.
+        self.num_experts = num_local_experts
+        self.global_num_experts = num_experts
+        self.num_local_experts = num_local_experts
+        self.local_expert_offset = local_expert_offset
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.intermediate_size_per_partition = intermediate_size
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.params_dtype = params_dtype or torch.get_default_dtype()
+        self.quant_config = quant_config
+        # SwiGLU, and no routed_scaling here -- Muse folds its route_scale into
+        # the topk weights before they reach us.
+        self.moe_runner_config = MoeRunnerConfig(activation="silu", is_gated=True)
+        self.dispatcher = _DirectDispatcher()
+        # post_expert_norm is unknown until set_post_expert_norm; start with the
+        # OSS default (standard, eps=1e-8) and rebuild when the real module arrives.
+        self._post_expert_norm: nn.Module | None = None
+        self._fused_finalize_op = FusedPostExpertNormWeightedSumTRTLLM(
+            topk=top_k, hidden_dim=hidden_size, eps=1e-8, weight_first=False
+        )
+        self.register_buffer("_post_expert_norm_weight", None, persistent=False)
+
+        self.quant_method = MuseSparkNvFp4FusedMoEMethod(quant_config)
+        if not self.quant_method.enable_flashinfer_trtllm_moe:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Packed NVFP4 experts need the FlashInfer TRT-LLM MoE backend, "
+                "which prepares the shuffled FP4 weights this forward reads. "
+                "Launch with --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm."
+            )
+        self.quant_method.create_weights(
+            layer=self,
+            num_experts=num_local_experts,
+            hidden_size=hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size_per_partition=intermediate_size,
+            params_dtype=self.params_dtype,
+            extra_weight_attrs={},
+        )
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def set_post_expert_norm(self, post_expert_norm: nn.Module | None) -> None:
+        """Cache the effective weight and norm form for the fused finalize.
+
+        Which form applies is selected by ``use_ffn_learnable_scales`` in the
+        model config (see ``models/muse_spark.py``): ``True`` selects
+        ``MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale`` (weight-first,
+        ``rms_norm(weight*x)``), ``False`` selects ``MuseSpark1xRMSNorm``
+        (standard, ``rms_norm(x) * weight``). The released checkpoint sets
+        ``True``, so deriving the form here is robustness rather than a
+        behaviour change for it; a ``False`` export would previously have been
+        mis-scaled by the hardcoded weight-first form.
+
+        ``post_expert_norm`` is *not* registered as a submodule — it already
+        belongs to the parent block, so registering it here would duplicate its
+        weight in ``state_dict`` and create a reference cycle.
+        """
+        if post_expert_norm is None:
+            # Bypass nn.Module.__setattr__ so None (and later the module) are
+            # not treated as submodules.
+            object.__setattr__(self, "_post_expert_norm", None)
+            self._post_expert_norm_weight = None
+            return
+        # Lazy import to avoid circular import at module load.
+        from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark.layers import (
+            MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale,
+        )
+
+        weight = post_expert_norm._get_effective_weight()
+        if weight is None:
+            weight = torch.ones(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                device=self.gemm1_weights_fp4_shuffled.device,
+            )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "_post_expert_norm", post_expert_norm)
+        self._post_expert_norm_weight = weight.detach().to(torch.bfloat16)
+        eps = float(getattr(post_expert_norm, "eps", 1e-8))
+        weight_first = isinstance(post_expert_norm, MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale)
+        # Rebuild the fused op with the correct eps/weight_first; the old
+        # op (wrong form) is discarded so it cannot silently mis-scale.
+        if (
+            self._fused_finalize_op.eps != eps
+            or self._fused_finalize_op.weight_first != weight_first
+        ):
+            self._fused_finalize_op = FusedPostExpertNormWeightedSumTRTLLM(
+                topk=self.top_k,
+                hidden_dim=self.hidden_size,
+                eps=eps,
+                weight_first=weight_first,
+            )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_scores: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        post_expert_norm: nn.Module | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        from flashinfer.fused_moe import trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe
+
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.pack_topk_ids import PackTopkIds
+
+        num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        if self.quant_config.use_per_token_activation:
+            # Calibration-free checkpoints ship activation scales of exactly 1.0,
+            # so the scale has to be computed per token at runtime instead.
+            from flashinfer import SfLayout, nvfp4_quantize
+
+            global_scale_inv = torch.full(
+                (1,),
+                _NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_SCALE_INV,
+                dtype=torch.float32,
+                device=hidden_states.device,
+            )
+            hs_fp4_bytes, hs_sf_bytes, per_token_scale = nvfp4_quantize(
+                hidden_states,
+                global_scale_inv,
+                sfLayout=SfLayout.layout_linear,
+                per_token_activation=True,
+                backend="cute-dsl",
+            )
+            seq_len, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
+            hs_fp4 = hs_fp4_bytes.reshape(seq_len, hidden_size // 2)
+            hs_scale_linear = hs_sf_bytes.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(
+                seq_len, hidden_size // 16
+            )
+        else:
+            # Match the known-good public vLLM activation path. SGLang's
+            # helper selects FlashInfer's experimental CuTeDSL quantizer on
+            # SM100, while vLLM's scaled_fp4_quant uses the stable CUDA
+            # implementation with a linear scale-factor layout.
+            from flashinfer import fp4_quantize
+
+            per_token_scale = None
+            hs_fp4_bytes, hs_sf_bytes = fp4_quantize(
+                hidden_states,
+                self.w13_input_scale_quant,
+                sf_vec_size=16,
+                sf_use_ue8m0=False,
+                is_sf_swizzled_layout=False,
+                backend="cuda",
+            )
+            seq_len, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
+            hs_fp4 = hs_fp4_bytes.reshape(seq_len, hidden_size // 2)
+            hs_scale_linear = hs_sf_bytes.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(
+                seq_len, hidden_size // 16
+            )
+        hs_scale = hs_scale_linear.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(
+            *hs_scale_linear.shape[:-1], -1
+        )
+        # The kernel takes ids and weights packed into one tensor. Muse has
+        # already materialized its own sigmoid top-k, so pack it directly rather
+        # than going through the runner's TopKOutput plumbing.
+        # The packer requires int32 ids and float32 weights; Muse's top-k comes
+        # out of torch.topk as int64.
+        packed_topk_ids = PackTopkIds.execute(
+            topk_ids.to(torch.int32).contiguous(),
+            topk_scores.to(torch.float32).contiguous(),
+        )
+
+        gemm2_out, expert_weights, expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx = (
+            trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe(
+                topk_ids=packed_topk_ids,
+                routing_bias=None,
+                hidden_states=hs_fp4,
+                hidden_states_scale=hs_scale,
+                gemm1_weights=self.gemm1_weights_fp4_shuffled,
+                gemm1_weights_scale=self.gemm1_scales_fp4_shuffled.view(
+                    torch.float8_e4m3fn
+                ),
+                gemm1_bias=None,
+                gemm1_alpha=getattr(self, "gemm1_alpha", None),
+                gemm1_beta=getattr(self, "gemm1_beta", None),
+                gemm1_clamp_limit=getattr(self, "gemm1_clamp_limit", None),
+                gemm2_weights=self.gemm2_weights_fp4_shuffled,
+                gemm2_weights_scale=self.gemm2_scales_fp4_shuffled.view(
+                    torch.float8_e4m3fn
+                ),
+                gemm2_bias=None,
+                output1_scale_scalar=self.g1_scale_c,
+                output1_scale_gate_scalar=self.g1_alphas,

+    x: torch.Tensor, gate: torch.Tensor, head_dim: int

+    """Return a zero-copy ``[tokens, groups, group_width]`` gate view."""
+    assert gate.ndim in (2, 3), "gate must be 2D or 3D"
+    if gate.ndim == 2:
+        assert gate.shape == x.shape, "flat gate shape must match x"
+        gate = gate.unsqueeze(1)
+    else:
+        assert gate.shape[0] == x.shape[0], "gate token dimension must match x"
+
+    assert gate.stride(-1) == 1, "gate's innermost dimension must be contiguous"
+    assert gate.shape[-1] % head_dim == 0, (
+        "gate group width must be divisible by head_dim"
+    )
+    assert gate.shape[1] * gate.shape[2] == x.shape[-1], (
+        "grouped gate width must match x"
+    )

+@triton.jit
+def _rms_norm_gate_fwd_kernel(
+    X,  # [N, D] input (contiguous, row-stride = D)
+    G,  # [T, groups, heads_per_group*D] gate values
+    Y,  # [N, D] output
+    W,  # [D] optional weight (effective weight, already adjusted for zcg)
+    eps,
+    N,  # total rows = tokens * H
+    H,  # number of heads (for mapping kernel row to g indices)
+    stride_g0,  # stride between gate tokens
+    stride_g1,  # stride between gate groups
+    HEADS_PER_GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    D: tl.constexpr,
+    BD: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_GATE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # BLOCK_M (token, head) rows per program; fp32 RMS reduction over head_dim.
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    rows = pid * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    row_mask = rows < N
+    cols = tl.arange(0, BD)
+    col_mask = cols < D
+    mask = row_mask[:, None] & col_mask[None, :]
+
+    x = tl.load(X + rows[:, None] * D + cols[None, :], mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+        tl.float32
+    )
+
+    if HAS_NORM:
+        var = tl.sum(tl.where(mask, x * x, 0.0), axis=1) / D
+        rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps)
+        x = x * rstd[:, None]
+        if HAS_WEIGHT:
+            w = tl.load(W + cols, mask=col_mask).to(tl.float32)
+            x = x * w[None, :]

+    if HAS_GATE:

+        head_idx = rows % H
+        group_idx = head_idx // HEADS_PER_GROUP
+        head_in_group = head_idx % HEADS_PER_GROUP
+        head_offset = group_idx * stride_g1 + head_in_group * D
+        g = tl.load(
+            G + token_idx[:, None] * stride_g0 + head_offset[:, None] + cols[None, :],
+            mask=mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)

+"""Fused post-norm + residual-add + pre-norm operation.
+
+Fuses the repeated pattern:
+    normed_branch = post_norm(branch)
+    new_stream    = residual_add(stream, normed_branch)
+    output        = pre_norm(new_stream.to(branch_dtype))
+
+This pattern appears twice per decoder layer:
+1. post_attn_norm + add_attn + pre_ffn_norm   (intra-layer)
+2. post_ffn_norm  + add_ffn  + pre_attn_norm  (cross-layer, deferred)
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark import fused_op_tuning
+from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark.base_fused_op import BaseFusedOp
+from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark.layers import (
+    MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection,
+    MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale,
+)
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _fused_norm_residual_config(
+    hidden_size: int,
+    m_bucket: int,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    post_norm_is_input_scale: bool,
+) -> tuple[int, int, dict]:
+    """Resolve launch parameters for the exact residual-norm shape."""
+    cfg = fused_op_tuning.resolve(
+        "fused_norm_residual",
+        {"num_warps": 8, "num_stages": 1},
+        hidden_size=hidden_size,
+        m_bucket=m_bucket,
+        num_tokens=num_tokens,
+        post_norm_is_input_scale=post_norm_is_input_scale,
+    )
+    extra = fused_op_tuning.split_extra(cfg, ("num_warps", "num_stages"))
+    return cfg["num_warps"], cfg["num_stages"], extra
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fused_norm_residual_triton_kernel(
+    BRANCH,
+    STREAM,
+    OUTPUT,
+    NEW_STREAM_OUT,
+    ROUTER_OUT,
+    OUT_FP8,
+    OUT_SCALE,
+    POST_WEIGHT,
+    PRE_WEIGHT,
+    ALPHA,
+    BETA,
+    post_norm_eps,
+    pre_norm_eps,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_NORM_IS_INPUT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_RESIDUAL_GATE: tl.constexpr,
+    RESIDUAL_GATE_CHANNEL_WISE: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_NORM_HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    PRE_NORM_HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_ROUTER: tl.constexpr,
+    PRE_NORM_BF16: tl.constexpr,
+    M_BUCKET: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_FP8: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    mask = offs < H
+
+    branch = tl.load(BRANCH + row * H + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+
+    if POST_NORM_IS_INPUT_SCALE:
+        post_input = branch
+        if POST_NORM_HAS_WEIGHT:
+            post_weight = tl.load(POST_WEIGHT + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+                tl.float32
+            )
+            post_input = (post_input * post_weight).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+        post_sum_sq = tl.sum(tl.where(mask, post_input * post_input, 0.0))
+        post_rstd = tl.rsqrt(post_sum_sq / H + post_norm_eps)
+        normed_branch = post_input * post_rstd
+    else:
+        post_sum_sq = tl.sum(tl.where(mask, branch * branch, 0.0))
+        post_rstd = tl.rsqrt(post_sum_sq / H + post_norm_eps)
+        normed_branch = branch * post_rstd
+        if POST_NORM_HAS_WEIGHT:
+            post_weight = tl.load(POST_WEIGHT + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+                tl.float32
+            )
+            normed_branch = normed_branch * post_weight
+
+    # MuseSpark1x norm modules return the input dtype. Branch tensors are bf16,
+    # so preserve the native bf16 round-trip before residual add.
+    normed_branch = normed_branch.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+
+    stream = tl.load(STREAM + row * H + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    if USE_RESIDUAL_GATE:
+        if RESIDUAL_GATE_CHANNEL_WISE:
+            alpha = tl.load(ALPHA + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+            beta = tl.load(BETA + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        else:
+            alpha = tl.load(ALPHA).to(tl.float32)
+            beta = tl.load(BETA).to(tl.float32)
+        new_stream = alpha * stream + beta * normed_branch
+    else:
+        new_stream = stream + normed_branch
+
+    tl.store(NEW_STREAM_OUT + row * H + offs, new_stream, mask=mask)
+
+    pre_input = new_stream
+    if PRE_NORM_BF16:
+        pre_input = pre_input.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+
+    pre_sum_sq = tl.sum(tl.where(mask, pre_input * pre_input, 0.0))
+    pre_rstd = tl.rsqrt(pre_sum_sq / H + pre_norm_eps)
+    normed = pre_input * pre_rstd
+    if PRE_NORM_HAS_WEIGHT:
+        pre_weight = tl.load(PRE_WEIGHT + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        normed = normed * pre_weight
+
+    if PRE_NORM_BF16:
+        normed = normed.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+
+    tl.store(OUTPUT + row * H + offs, normed, mask=mask)
+    if HAS_ROUTER:
+        tl.store(ROUTER_OUT + row * H + offs, normed, mask=mask)
+    if HAS_FP8:
+        # per-row FP8 e4m3 copy for the next layer's FP8 QKV GEMM (448 = e4m3 max)
+        scale = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.where(mask, tl.abs(normed), 0.0)), 1e-20) / 448.0
+        tl.store(
+            OUT_FP8 + row * H + offs, (normed / scale).to(tl.float8e4nv), mask=mask
+        )
+        tl.store(OUT_SCALE + row, scale)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# JIT compilation for the CUDA C kernel
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+class FusedPostNormResidualPreNorm(BaseFusedOp):
+    """Fuses: post_norm(branch) + residual_add(stream, normed) + pre_norm(new_stream).
+
+    Backends:
+    - ``forward_native``: sequential PyTorch calls (reference implementation).
+    - ``forward_torch_compile``: ``torch.compile``'d native.
+    - ``forward_triton``: the fused kernel.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, post_norm, residual_add, pre_norm):
+        # Store module references (weights are owned by the decoder layer module tree)
+        self._post_norm = post_norm
+        self._residual_add = residual_add
+        self._pre_norm = pre_norm
+
+        # Introspection flags for CUDA C kernel template specialization
+        self._post_norm_is_input_scale = isinstance(
+            post_norm, MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale
+        )
+        self._use_residual_gate = isinstance(
+            residual_add, MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection
+        )
+        self._pre_norm_is_input_scale = isinstance(
+            pre_norm, MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale
+        )
+        self._hidden_size = post_norm.hidden_size
+        super().__init__()
+
+    def forward_native(
+        self,
+        stream: torch.Tensor,
+        branch: torch.Tensor,
+        branch_dtype: torch.dtype = torch.bfloat16,
+        router_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+        pre_norm_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        """Reference implementation: call each module in sequence.
+
+        Args:
+            stream: residual stream ``[T, H]`` in residual dtype (e.g. fp32).
+            branch: raw output from attention or MoE ``[T, H]`` in compute dtype.
+            branch_dtype: dtype to cast pre-norm input to (default ``torch.bfloat16``).
+            router_dtype: when set, also return the pre-norm output cast to this
+                dtype (e.g. ``torch.float32`` for MoE router input), fusing the
+                cast into this op instead of doing it separately downstream.
+            pre_norm_dtype: when set, cast new_stream to this dtype before pre_norm
+                (e.g. ``torch.bfloat16`` for the final layer's numerical parity).
+
+        Returns:
+            output: pre-normalized result for the next compute block ``[T, H]``
+                in *branch_dtype*.
+            new_stream: updated residual stream ``[T, H]`` in the original
+                residual dtype.
+            router_input: pre-norm output cast to *router_dtype*, or ``None``
+                when *router_dtype* is not set.

+        normed_branch = self._post_norm(branch)
+        new_stream = self._residual_add(stream, normed_branch)
+        norm_input = (
+            new_stream.to(pre_norm_dtype) if pre_norm_dtype is not None else new_stream
+        )
+        normed = self._pre_norm(norm_input)
+        output = normed.to(branch_dtype)
+        router_input = normed.to(router_dtype) if router_dtype is not None else None
+        return output, new_stream, router_input
+
+    def _triton_supported(
+        self,
+        stream: torch.Tensor,
+        branch: torch.Tensor,
+        branch_dtype: torch.dtype,
+        router_dtype: torch.dtype | None,
+        pre_norm_dtype: torch.dtype | None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        return (
+            branch.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and branch_dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and stream.dtype == torch.float32
+            and (router_dtype is None or router_dtype == torch.float32)
+            and (pre_norm_dtype is None or pre_norm_dtype == torch.bfloat16)
+            and branch.dim() == 2
+            and stream.dim() == 2
+            and branch.shape == stream.shape

+            if hasattr(mod, "weight") and mod.weight is not None:
+                device = mod.weight.device
+                break
+        if device is None and self._use_residual_gate:
+            device = self._residual_add._alpha.device
+
+        self._cc_post_weight = (
+            self._post_norm._get_effective_weight().to(branch_dtype).contiguous()
+            if self._post_norm.has_weight
+            else torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        )
+        self._cc_pre_weight = (
+            self._pre_norm._get_effective_weight().to(branch_dtype).contiguous()
+            if self._pre_norm.has_weight
+            else torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        )

+            ra = self._residual_add
+            if ra._alpha is not None:

+            self._cc_beta = beta.reshape(-1).float().contiguous()
+        else:
+            self._cc_alpha = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+            self._cc_beta = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        self._cc_empty_fp32 = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        self._weights_cached = True
+
+    def forward_triton(
+        self,
+        stream: torch.Tensor,
+        branch: torch.Tensor,

+        ):

+                self.forward_native(
+                    stream, branch, branch_dtype, router_dtype, pre_norm_dtype=pre_norm_dtype
+                )
+                if branch.numel() == 0
+                else self._fallback_triton_to_native(
+                    stream, branch, branch_dtype, router_dtype, pre_norm_dtype=pre_norm_dtype
+                )

+            return (*res, *quantize_rows(res[0]))

+        self._ensure_cached_weights(branch_dtype)

+            self._cc_pre_weight,
+            self._cc_alpha,
+            self._cc_beta,

+            self._pre_norm.eps,

+            self._use_residual_gate,

+    def forward_fp8(
+        self,
+        stream: torch.Tensor,

+"""Hardware- and shape-keyed launch configs for the fused Triton ops.
+
+Mirrors the FlashInfer autotune-config pattern (a JSON per GPU, keyed on shape):
+``autotune_configs/fused_triton_ops/<hardware_key>.json`` holds, per op, an ordered
+list of rules ``{"when": {...}, <launch_param>: <val>, ...}`` (first match wins).
+Each op passes a portable default to :func:`resolve`, used whenever no rule matches.
+
+``<hardware_key>`` is the GCN arch on ROCm (``gfx950``, shared across MI350X/
+MI355X) and the normalized device name on CUDA (``NVIDIA_GB300``). ``when`` keys
+are ``<param>`` (equality) or ``<param>_{lt,le,ge,gt,eq}``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import operator
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from functools import cache
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+
+# Shares the curated-config tree with the FlashInfer autotune configs; this module
+# lives in srt/ops/, so parent.parent == srt/.
+_CONFIG_DIR = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "autotune_configs" / "fused_triton_ops"
+)
+_METADATA_KEY = "_metadata"
+
+_COMPARATORS = {
+    "lt": operator.lt,
+    "le": operator.le,
+    "ge": operator.ge,
+    "gt": operator.gt,
+    "eq": operator.eq,
+}
+
+
+@cache
+def _hardware_key(device_index: int = 0) -> str | None:
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return None
+    return "_".join(torch.cuda.get_device_name(device_index).split())
+
+
+def _make_predicate(when: dict) -> Callable[[dict], bool]:
+    checks = []
+    for field, expected in when.items():
+        param, _, suffix = field.rpartition("_")
+        if param and suffix in _COMPARATORS:
+            checks.append((param, _COMPARATORS[suffix], expected))
+        else:
+            checks.append((field, operator.eq, expected))
+
+    def predicate(shape: dict) -> bool:
+        return all(p in shape and cmp(shape[p], exp) for p, cmp, exp in checks)
+
+    return predicate
+
+
+@cache
+def _load(hardware_key: str | None) -> dict[str, list[tuple[Callable, dict]]]:
+    if hardware_key is None:
+        return {}
+    path = _CONFIG_DIR / f"{hardware_key}.json"
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        return {}
+    compiled: dict[str, list[tuple[Callable, dict]]] = {}
+    for op_name, rules in data.items():
+        if op_name == _METADATA_KEY:
+            continue
+        compiled[op_name] = [
+            (
+                _make_predicate(rule.get("when", {})),
+                {k: v for k, v in rule.items() if k != "when"},
+            )
+            for rule in rules
+        ]
+    return compiled
+
+
+def _resolve(
+    hardware_key: str | None, op_name: str, defaults: dict, shape: dict
+) -> dict:
+    for predicate, config in _load(hardware_key).get(op_name, ()):
+        if predicate(shape):
+            return {**defaults, **config}
+    return dict(defaults)
+
+
+def resolve(op_name: str, defaults: dict, *, device_index: int = 0, **shape) -> dict:
+    """First matching rule for this GPU + ``shape``, merged over ``defaults``."""
+    return _resolve(_hardware_key(device_index), op_name, defaults, shape)
+
+
+def split_extra(config: dict, consumed: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict:
+    """Config params not consumed positionally => extra Triton kwargs (drop None)."""
+    return {k: v for k, v in config.items() if k not in consumed and v is not None}

+"""Fused post-expert norm + weighted sum for TRTLLM MoE finalize.
+
+Fuses three operations per token when using TRTLLM MoE with ``do_finalize=False``:
+1. Gather expert output from permuted positions (unpermute)
+2. Apply weight-first RMSNorm (multiply by weight+1.0, then normalize)
+3. Weighted accumulation across top-K experts
+
+Backends:
+- native: pure PyTorch (loop over experts)
+- cutedsl: vectorized 128-bit tiled copies with TensorSSA reductions
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import is_arch_support_pdl
+from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark import fi_trtllm_moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm_cutedsl
+from sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark.base_fused_op import BaseFusedOp, FusedOpBackend
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+_missing_cutedsl_warning_logged = False
+
+# Upper bound on the finalize grid (one block per token) for launching with
+# PDL. PDL blocks camp on their SM slots in griddepcontrol_wait and cannot
+# retire until the producer grid completes, so a grid larger than what fits
+# resident in one wave can occupy every slot and starve the producer GEMM's
+# remaining thread-block clusters — a device-side deadlock that stalls this
+# rank's stream and, through the MoE all-to-all combine, every EP peer.
+# 1024 blocks stay well
+# below one resident wave (~148 SMs x 16 blocks/SM), preserving the PDL
+# launch-latency win for decode-sized batches while keeping prefill-sized
+# grids on the plain stream-ordered path.
+_PDL_MAX_NUM_TOKENS = 1024
+
+
+def _should_use_pdl(num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+    return is_arch_support_pdl() and num_tokens <= _PDL_MAX_NUM_TOKENS
+
+
+class FusedPostExpertNormWeightedSumTRTLLM(BaseFusedOp):
+    """Fused unpermute + RMSNorm + weighted sum for TRTLLM MoE finalize.
+
+    This op handles the post-processing of TRTLLM MoE output when called with
+    ``do_finalize=False``. It combines unpermuting from the TRT-LLM permuted
+    layout, applying RMSNorm, and weighted accumulation across top-K experts
+    into a single kernel.
+
+    The RMSNorm form is configurable: weight-first (``rms_norm(weight * x)``)
+    or standard (``x / rms(x) * weight``). Eps is also configurable so the
+    kernel reproduces the same math as the Python ``MuseSpark1xRMSNorm`` modules.
+
+    Args:
+        topk: Number of experts per token.
+        hidden_dim: Output hidden dimension (may differ from gemm2 padded width).
+        eps: RMSNorm epsilon. Must match the ``post_expert_norm.eps`` of the
+            model being served (OSS default ``1e-8``).
+        weight_first: If True, implements weight-first ``rms_norm(weight*x)``;
+            if False, implements standard ``rms_norm(x) * weight``.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        topk: int,
+        hidden_dim: int,
+        eps: float = 1e-8,
+        weight_first: bool = True,
+    ):
+        self.topk = topk
+        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
+        self.eps = float(eps)
+        self.weight_first = bool(weight_first)
+        super().__init__()
+
+    def _backend_runtime_eligible(self, backend, *args, **kwargs) -> bool:
+        if backend is not FusedOpBackend.CUTEDSL:
+            return True
+        if not fi_trtllm_moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm_cutedsl.HAS_CUTEDSL:
+            global _missing_cutedsl_warning_logged
+            if not _missing_cutedsl_warning_logged:
+                _missing_cutedsl_warning_logged = True
+                logger.warning(
+                    "CuTeDSL dependencies are unavailable; falling back to the "
+                    "PyTorch NVFP4 MoE finalize implementation."
+                )
+            return False
+        gemm2_output = args[0] if args else kwargs["gemm2_output"]
+        return gemm2_output.is_cuda
+
+    def forward_native(
+        self,
+        gemm2_output: torch.Tensor,
+        expert_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx: torch.Tensor,
+        rms_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Pure PyTorch fallback for fused finalize + RMSNorm.
+
+        Args:
+            gemm2_output: Permuted GEMM2 output [total_permuted_tokens, hidden_dim_padded].
+            expert_weights: Router weights [num_tokens, topk] or [num_tokens * topk], bfloat16.
+            expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx: Index mapping [num_tokens * topk], int32.
+                -1 indicates the expert should be skipped.
+            rms_norm_weight: RMSNorm weight [hidden_dim] with 1.0 pre-added.
+            output: Output tensor [num_tokens, hidden_dim]. Zeroed by this function.
+        """
+        topk = self.topk
+        hidden_dim = self.hidden_dim
+        num_tokens = output.shape[0]
+        idx_2d = expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.view(num_tokens, topk)
+        weights_2d = expert_weights.view(num_tokens, topk).to(torch.float32)
+
+        output.zero_()
+        for k in range(topk):
+            perm_idx = idx_2d[:, k]  # [num_tokens]
+            # No .any() early-out: a host sync here breaks CUDA graph capture;
+            # the `valid` mask below already zeroes skipped experts.
+            valid = perm_idx >= 0
+            # Gather expert output rows
+            gathered = gemm2_output[perm_idx.clamp(min=0)][:, :hidden_dim]
+            w = rms_norm_weight.float()
+            if self.weight_first:
+                # Weight-first: rms_norm(weight * x)
+                scaled = gathered.float() * w
+                inv_rms = torch.rsqrt(
+                    scaled.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps
+                )
+                normalized = scaled * inv_rms
+            else:
+                # Standard: rms_norm(x) * weight
+                inv_rms = torch.rsqrt(
+                    gathered.float().pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps
+                )
+                normalized = gathered.float() * inv_rms * w
+            # Weighted accumulation. Select, don't multiply-mask: invalid
+            # lanes gather garbage rows (clamp(0) on a possibly fully
+            # unwritten torch.empty gemm2_output — a rank whose local experts
+            # got zero hits never writes any row) and 0 * NaN = NaN would
+            # poison the sum. torch.where drops the unselected branch without
+            # a host-sync branch, so this stays stream-capture safe.
+            w = weights_2d[:, k : k + 1]
+            contribution = torch.where(
+                valid.unsqueeze(-1), w * normalized, torch.zeros_like(normalized)
+            ).to(output.dtype)
+            output += contribution
+
+    def forward_cutedsl(
+        self,
+        gemm2_output: torch.Tensor,
+        expert_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx: torch.Tensor,
+        rms_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        """CuTeDSL kernel: vectorized unpermute + RMSNorm + weighted accumulate.
+
+        Args:
+            gemm2_output: Permuted GEMM2 output [total_permuted_tokens, hidden_dim_padded].
+            expert_weights: Router weights [num_tokens, topk] or [num_tokens * topk], bfloat16.
+            expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx: Index mapping [num_tokens * topk], int32.
+                -1 indicates the expert should be skipped.
+            rms_norm_weight: RMSNorm weight [hidden_dim] with 1.0 pre-added.
+            output: Output tensor [num_tokens, hidden_dim].
+        """
+        import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+        from cutlass import BFloat16, Int32
+        from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_ptr
+
+        kernel_module = fi_trtllm_moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm_cutedsl
+
+        assert gemm2_output.is_cuda
+        cutlass_dtype = kernel_module._torch_to_cutlass_dtype[gemm2_output.dtype]
+
+        num_tokens = output.shape[0]
+        hidden_dim_padded = gemm2_output.shape[1]
+
+        assert expert_weights.dtype == torch.bfloat16, (
+            f"expert_weights must be bfloat16, got {expert_weights.dtype}"
+        )
+        assert expert_weights.is_contiguous(), "expert_weights must be contiguous"
+        expert_weights_flat = expert_weights.view(-1)
+
+        assert expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.dtype == torch.int32, (
+            f"expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx must be int32, got "
+            f"{expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.dtype}"
+        )
+        assert expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.is_contiguous(), (
+            "expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx must be contiguous"
+        )
+        idx_flat = expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.view(-1)
+
+        torch_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        stream = cuda.CUstream(torch_stream.cuda_stream)
+
+        compiled_kernel = kernel_module._get_compiled_kernel(
+            cutlass_dtype,
+            self.hidden_dim,
+            self.topk,
+            hidden_dim_padded,
+            stream,
+            use_pdl=_should_use_pdl(num_tokens),
+            eps=self.eps,
+            weight_first=self.weight_first,
+        )
+
+        gemm2_ptr = make_ptr(cutlass_dtype, gemm2_output.data_ptr())
+        expw_ptr = make_ptr(BFloat16, expert_weights_flat.data_ptr())
+        idx_ptr = make_ptr(Int32, idx_flat.data_ptr())
+        rmsw_ptr = make_ptr(cutlass_dtype, rms_norm_weight.data_ptr())
+        out_ptr = make_ptr(cutlass_dtype, output.data_ptr())
+
+        compiled_kernel(
+            gemm2_ptr,
+            expw_ptr,
+            idx_ptr,
+            rmsw_ptr,
+            out_ptr,
+            Int32(num_tokens),
+            stream,
+        )

+"""Small, torch-native layer primitives used by the Muse Spark model."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import enum
+import math
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed import divide
+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    LinearParallelGroup,
+    resolve_linear_parallel_group,
+)
+
+
+class GainCenterType(enum.Enum):
+    ONE = "one"
+    ZERO = "zero"
+    INVERSE_RESIDUAL_INDEX = "inverse_residual_index"
+    INVERSE_RESIDUAL_INDEX_V2 = "inverse_residual_index_v2"
+    INVERSE_SQRT_RESIDUAL_INDEX = "inverse_sqrt_residual_index"
+    INVERSE_SQRT_LAYERS = "inverse_sqrt_layers"
+
+
+def calculate_gain_center(
+    gain_center_type: str, residual_id: int, n_layers: int | None = None
+) -> float:
+    gain_center = GainCenterType(gain_center_type)
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.ONE:
+        return 1.0
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.ZERO:
+        return 0.0
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.INVERSE_RESIDUAL_INDEX:
+        return 1.0 / (2.0 * math.ceil(residual_id / 2.0))
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.INVERSE_RESIDUAL_INDEX_V2:
+        return 1.0 / (residual_id + 1.0)
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.INVERSE_SQRT_RESIDUAL_INDEX:
+        return 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0 * math.ceil(residual_id / 2.0))
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.INVERSE_SQRT_LAYERS:
+        if n_layers is None:
+            raise ValueError("n_layers is required for inverse_sqrt_layers")
+        return 1.0 / math.sqrt(n_layers)
+    raise ValueError(f"Unknown gain_center_type: {gain_center_type}")
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        eps: float = 1e-6,
+        has_weight: bool = True,
+        is_post_norm: bool = False,
+        zero_centered_gamma: bool = False,
+        post_norm_gain_center_type: str = "one",
+        output_norm_gain_center_type: str = "zero",
+        residual_id: int | None = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.has_weight = has_weight
+        self.zero_centered_gamma = zero_centered_gamma
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(hidden_size)) if has_weight else None
+        self.gain_center = 1.0
+        if residual_id is not None and is_post_norm:
+            self.gain_center = calculate_gain_center(
+                post_norm_gain_center_type, residual_id
+            )
+        elif residual_id == -1:
+            self.gain_center = calculate_gain_center(
+                output_norm_gain_center_type, residual_id
+            )
+
+    def _get_effective_weight(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        if self.weight is None:
+            return None
+        cached = getattr(self, "_effective_weight_cache", None)
+        if cached is not None:
+            return cached
+        if self.zero_centered_gamma:
+            return self.weight + self.gain_center
+        return self.weight
+
+    def cache_effective_weight(self) -> None:
+        """Materialize ``weight + gain_center`` once (call after weights are loaded, never
+        inside a CUDA-graph capture) so forward() stops launching an add kernel per call."""
+        if self.weight is None:
+            return
+        self._effective_weight_cache = None
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            self._effective_weight_cache = self._get_effective_weight().detach().clone()
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if x.numel() == 0:
+            return x
+        dtype = x.dtype
+        return F.rms_norm(
+            x, (self.hidden_size,), self._get_effective_weight(), self.eps
+        ).to(dtype)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale(MuseSpark1xRMSNorm):
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if x.numel() == 0:
+            return x
+        dtype = x.dtype
+        weight = self._get_effective_weight()
+        if weight is not None:
+            x = weight * x
+        return F.rms_norm(x, (self.hidden_size,), None, self.eps).to(dtype)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xResidualConnection(nn.Module):
+    def forward(self, stream: torch.Tensor, branch: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return stream + branch.to(stream.dtype)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection(nn.Module):
+    """Training-compatible gated residual implemented only with torch ops."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dim: int,
+        temperature: float = 0.3,
+        channel_wise: bool = True,
+        use_stream_gate: bool = True,
+        eps: float = 1e-3,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.temperature = temperature
+        self.use_stream_gate = use_stream_gate
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.gate = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(dim if channel_wise else 1))
+        self.register_buffer("_alpha", None, persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("_beta", None, persistent=False)
+
+    def _coefficients(
+        self, w: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor | float, torch.Tensor]:
+        beta = torch.sigmoid(w)
+        if not self.use_stream_gate:
+            return 1.0, beta
+        alpha_sq = torch.sigmoid(-w) * (1.0 + beta)
+        return torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(alpha_sq, min=self.eps)), beta
+
+    def precompute_coefficients(self) -> None:
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            alpha, beta = self._coefficients(
+                self.gate.view(1, -1).float() / self.temperature
+            )
+            self._alpha = (
+                alpha if isinstance(alpha, torch.Tensor) else torch.tensor(alpha)
+            )
+            self._beta = beta
+
+    def forward(self, stream: torch.Tensor, branch: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if stream.numel() == 0:
+            return stream
+        if self._alpha is None:
+            alpha, beta = self._coefficients(
+                self.gate.view(1, -1).float() / self.temperature
+            )
+        else:
+            alpha, beta = self._alpha, self._beta
+        return (alpha * stream + beta * branch.to(stream.dtype)).to(stream.dtype)
+
+
+class QKVOGateParallelLinear(ColumnParallelLinear):
+    """Tensor-parallel Q/K/V projection with one additional query-sized gate."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        head_size: int,
+        total_num_heads: int,
+        total_num_kv_heads: int | None = None,
+        bias: bool = False,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        parallel_group: LinearParallelGroup = "attn_tp",
+    ):
+        total_num_kv_heads = total_num_kv_heads or total_num_heads
+        tp_rank, tp_size = resolve_linear_parallel_group(parallel_group)
+        self.tp_rank = tp_rank
+        self.tp_size = tp_size
+        self.num_heads = divide(total_num_heads, tp_size)
+        if tp_size >= total_num_kv_heads:
+            self.num_kv_heads = 1
+            self.num_kv_head_replicas = divide(tp_size, total_num_kv_heads)
+        else:
+            self.num_kv_heads = divide(total_num_kv_heads, tp_size)
+            self.num_kv_head_replicas = 1
+        self.q_proj_shard_size = self.num_heads * head_size
+        self.kv_proj_shard_size = self.num_kv_heads * head_size
+        self.g_proj_shard_size = self.q_proj_shard_size
+        local = (
+            self.q_proj_shard_size
+            + 2 * self.kv_proj_shard_size
+            + self.g_proj_shard_size
+        )
+        super().__init__(
+            input_size=hidden_size,
+            output_size=local * tp_size,
+            bias=bias,
+            gather_output=False,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=prefix,
+            parallel_group=parallel_group,
+        )
+
+    def weight_loader(
+        self,
+        param: nn.Parameter,
+        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        loaded_shard_id: str | None = None,
+    ):
+        if loaded_shard_id not in ("q", "k", "v", "g"):
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported QKV gate shard: {loaded_shard_id}")
+        sizes = {
+            "q": self.q_proj_shard_size,
+            "k": self.kv_proj_shard_size,
+            "v": self.kv_proj_shard_size,
+            "g": self.g_proj_shard_size,
+        }
+        offsets = {
+            "q": 0,
+            "k": self.q_proj_shard_size,
+            "v": self.q_proj_shard_size + self.kv_proj_shard_size,
+            "g": self.q_proj_shard_size + 2 * self.kv_proj_shard_size,
+        }
+        output_dim = getattr(param, "output_dim", 0)
+        shard_size = sizes[loaded_shard_id]
+        param_data = param.data.narrow(output_dim, offsets[loaded_shard_id], shard_size)
+        if loaded_shard_id in ("q", "g"):
+            start = self.tp_rank * shard_size
+        else:
+            start = (self.tp_rank // self.num_kv_head_replicas) * shard_size
+        param_data.copy_(loaded_weight.narrow(output_dim, start, shard_size))

+"""Muse Spark compact A4 verify experts (gfx950): the EP4 64-expert launch matches two EP8 32-expert launches."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported, is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=60, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (is_hip() and is_gfx95_supported()), reason="Tuned for MI355X (gfx950)."
+)
+
+
+def _inputs(m, local_start, experts):
+    torch.manual_seed(m * 1000 + experts)
+    dev = "cuda"
+    x = (torch.randn(m, 4096, device=dev) * 0.5).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    # Random MXFP4 nibbles and E8M0 scales near 2^0 keep the GEMMs finite.
+    w13 = torch.randint(0, 256, (experts, 8192, 2048), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    w2 = torch.randint(0, 256, (experts, 4096, 2048), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    s13 = torch.randint(118, 124, (experts, 8192, 128), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    s2 = torch.randint(118, 124, (experts, 4096, 128), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    # Each token routes to 8 distinct experts; about a third land outside this rank.
+    pool = torch.arange(
+        local_start - experts // 2, local_start + experts + experts // 2, device=dev
+    )
+    ids = torch.stack(
+        [pool[torch.randperm(pool.numel(), device=dev)[:8]] for _ in range(m)]
+    )
+    return x, ids.int().contiguous(), w13, w2, s13, s2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", [8, 16, 64, 192, 512])
+def test_compact_a4_local64_matches_two_local32(m):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.mxfp4_compact_a4_moe import compact_a4_experts
+
+    start = 64
+    x, ids, w13, w2, s13, s2 = _inputs(m, start, 64)
+    got = compact_a4_experts(x, ids, w13, w2, s13, s2, local_start=start)
+    flat = ids.flatten()
+    for half in (0, 1):
+        lo = start + 32 * half
+        sl = slice(32 * half, 32 * half + 32)
+        ref = compact_a4_experts(
+            x,
+            ids,
+            w13[sl].contiguous(),
+            w2[sl].contiguous(),
+            s13[sl].contiguous(),
+            s2[sl].contiguous(),
+            local_start=lo,
+        )
+        rows = ((flat >= lo) & (flat < lo + 32)).nonzero().flatten()
+        assert rows.numel() > 0
+        assert torch.equal(got[rows], ref[rows])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("experts", [32, 64])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", [8, 128, 512])
+def test_compact_a4_reads_a4w4_preshuffled_weights(experts, m):
+    """The a4w4 preshuffled copy (the only one kept when both do not fit) gives the stored-layout result."""
+    from aiter import dtypes
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import (
+        shuffle_scale_a16w4,
+        shuffle_weight,
+        shuffle_weight_a16w4,
+    )
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.mxfp4_compact_a4_moe import compact_a4_experts
+
+    start = experts
+    x, ids, w13, w2, s13, s2 = _inputs(m, start, experts)
+    e = experts
+    shuffled = (
+        shuffle_weight(w13.view(dtypes.fp4x2), (16, 16)),
+        shuffle_weight_a16w4(w2.view(dtypes.fp4x2), 16, False),
+        e8m0_shuffle(s13.view(dtypes.fp8_e8m0).view(e * 8192, 128)),
+        shuffle_scale_a16w4(s2.view(dtypes.fp8_e8m0).view(e * 4096, 128), e, False),
+    )
+    views = [
+        t.view(torch.uint8).view(e, n, k)
+        for t, (n, k) in zip(

+        )

+    ref = compact_a4_experts(x, ids, w13, w2, s13, s2, local_start=start)

+    flat = ids.flatten()
+    rows = ((flat >= start) & (flat < start + e)).nonzero().flatten()

+"""Muse Spark routing front (gfx950): FP32 router + BF16 pooler with the shared top-8 / RMSNorm epilogue."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported, is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=30, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (is_hip() and is_gfx95_supported()), reason="Tuned for MI355X (gfx950)."
+)
+
+MULT, SCALE, EPS = 1.5, 2.5, 1e-6
+
+
+def _reference(x, router_w, pooler_w, bias, norm_w):
+    scores = torch.sigmoid((x.double() @ router_w.double()) * MULT)
+    ids = torch.topk(scores + bias.double(), 8, dim=-1).indices
+    top = scores.gather(1, ids)
+    top = top * (SCALE / (top.sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-15))
+    pooled = F.linear(x, pooler_w).float()
+    pooled = (
+        pooled
+        * torch.rsqrt(pooled.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+        * norm_w.float()
+    )
+    return top.float(), ids.int(), pooled
+
+
+def _inputs(m):
+    torch.manual_seed(m)
+    x = torch.randn(m, 8192, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    router_w = torch.randn(8192, 256, device="cuda") * 0.02
+    pooler_w = (torch.randn(4096, 8192, device="cuda") * 0.02).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    bias = torch.randn(256, device="cuda") * 0.01
+    norm_w = (torch.rand(4096, device="cuda") + 0.5).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    return x, router_w, pooler_w, bias, norm_w
+
+
+def _check(got, ref):
+    scores, ids, pooled = got
+    rs, rid, rp = ref
+    assert torch.equal(torch.sort(ids, -1).values, torch.sort(rid, -1).values)
+    order, rorder = torch.argsort(ids, -1), torch.argsort(rid, -1)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        scores.gather(1, order), rs.gather(1, rorder), rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(pooled.float(), rp, rtol=3e-2, atol=3e-2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rowmajor", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", [1, 8, 16, 24, 48, 64])
+def test_router_pooler_topk(m, rowmajor):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.router_pooler_topk import router_pooler_topk
+
+    x, router_w, pooler_w, bias, norm_w = _inputs(m)
+    got = router_pooler_topk(
+        x, router_w, pooler_w, bias, norm_w, MULT, SCALE, EPS, pooler_rowmajor=rowmajor
+    )
+    _check(got, _reference(x, router_w, pooler_w, bias, norm_w))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", [8, 16, 24, 48, 64])
+def test_joint_router_pooler_topk(m):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.mxfp4_compact_a4_moe import _prepare_a4
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.router_pooler_topk import (
+        joint_router_pooler_applies,

+        pack_joint_router_pooler_weight,

+    assert torch.equal(packed[:4096], pooler_w)
+    assert joint_router_pooler_applies(x, packed)

+"""DFlash grouped conv kernels (gfx950): the input conv fed by the projection's split-K partials and the output
+conv fused with the residual add + RMSNorm, against the eager formula."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported, is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=60, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (is_hip() and is_gfx95_supported()), reason="Tuned for MI355X (gfx950)."
+)
+
+
+def _close(a, b):
+    # BF16 roundings of FP32 sums taken in different orders: a few ULPs of the largest operand at worst
+    # (sums that cancel), about one rounding (2^-9) of relative L2 error overall.
+    a, b = a.float(), b.float()
+    err = (a - b).abs()
+    assert err.max() <= 2**-6 * b.abs().max(), err.max()
+    assert err.norm() <= 4e-3 * b.norm(), err.norm() / b.norm()
+
+
+def _eager_add_rmsnorm(x, residual, weight, eps):
+    s = x.float() + residual.float()
+    y = s * torch.rsqrt(s.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    return (y * weight.float()).to(x.dtype), s.to(x.dtype)
+
+
+# (hidden, groups, taps, block): the TP4 Muse Spark draft, and a 3-tap conv on a block size that is not a power
+# of two (positions are taken modulo the block, so taps must not reach into the previous request's block).
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("h,groups,taps,block", [(8192, 512, 2, 8), (1024, 64, 3, 5)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [24, 40, 64, 128])
+def test_conv_kernels_match_eager(h, groups, taps, block, rows):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dflash_grouped_conv import (
+        conv_finish_add_rmsnorm,
+        conv_prepare,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.models.dflash import _grouped_conv
+
+    torch.manual_seed(rows)
+    x = torch.randn(rows, h, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    y = torch.randn(rows, h, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    residual = torch.randn(rows, h, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    weight = (1 + 0.1 * torch.randn(h, device="cuda")).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    base = (0.1 * torch.randn(2, taps, h, device="cuda")).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    base[:, 0] += 1
+    w = (0.01 * torch.randn(2 * taps * groups, h, device="cuda")).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    projection = F.linear(x, w)
+    delta = projection.view(rows, 2, taps, groups)
+    gs = h // groups
+
+    def conv(inp, side):
+        # The eager formula in FP32: the kernels round once, the BF16 eager formula after every op.
+        return _grouped_conv.__wrapped__(
+            inp.float(),
+            delta[:, side].float(),
+            base[side].float(),
+            block,
+            groups,
+            gs,
+            taps,
+        )
+
+    # Split-K partials (summed in the kernel) and the BF16 product give the same deltas.
+    partials = torch.stack([F.linear(x[:, i::2], w[:, i::2]).float() for i in range(2)])
+    for source in (projection, partials):
+        out, d1 = conv_prepare(
+            source, x, base[0], block_size=block, taps=taps, num_groups=groups
+        )
+        _close(out, conv(x, 0))
+        _close(d1, delta[:, 1])
+
+    ref = _eager_add_rmsnorm(conv(y, 1).to(torch.bfloat16), residual, weight, 1e-5)
+    got = conv_finish_add_rmsnorm(
+        y, delta[:, 1], base[1], residual, weight, 1e-5, block_size=block
+    )

+def test_merged_candidates_match_topk_of_full_vocab(tp, softcap):
+    """Per-shard packed top-k (one all-gather) merged in one kernel gives the full-vocabulary top-k: global ids
+    offset by each shard's start and exact in FP32, values descending with the unary transform; a shard's
+    winners may straddle its 1024-column chunks and the ragged last chunk."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dflash_candidates import (
+        merge_candidates,
+        topk_packed,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(tp)
+    rows, shard, k, multiplier = 64, 50512, 16, 0.1767766952966369
+    logits = torch.randn(rows, tp * shard, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    # Distinct winners so the expected order has no ties; some rows pack them into one shard's last chunk.
+    winners = torch.rand(rows, tp * shard, device="cuda").argsort(-1)[:, : 4 * k]
+    winners[::4] = shard - 1 - torch.arange(4 * k, device="cuda")
+    logits.scatter_(
+        1,
+        winners,
+        (10 + torch.arange(4 * k, device="cuda") / 8)
+        .to(torch.bfloat16)
+        .expand(rows, -1)
+        .contiguous(),
+    )
+    packed = [
+        topk_packed(logits[:, r * shard : (r + 1) * shard], k, r * shard)
+        for r in range(tp)
+    ]
+    ids, vals = merge_candidates(
+        torch.cat(packed, -1), k, multiplier=multiplier, softcap=softcap
+    )
+    top, want_ids = torch.topk(logits.float(), k, dim=-1)
+    want = top * multiplier
+    if softcap is not None:
+        want = torch.tanh(want / softcap) * softcap
+    assert torch.equal(ids, want_ids)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(vals, want, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6)

+"""Target verify on vocab-sharded logits (SGLANG_MUSE_SHARDED_GREEDY_LOGITS): the
+per-shard softcapped argmax merged across shards must equal torch.argmax of the
+all-gathered softcapped logits, exact ties included, and the gathered bonus rows must
+equal the same rows of the full gather. The 4-way sharding is faked on one GPU: shards
+are column slices and the all-gather is torch.stack."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.activation.softcap import gathered_softcap_logits
+from sglang.kernels.ops.sampling.softcap_row_argmax import (
+    merge_row_argmax_shards,
+    softcap_row_argmax,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.simulated_bonus import (
+    simulated_bonus_sample,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=30, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="Triton kernels need a GPU."
+)
+
+WORLD = 4
+# Muse Spark: vocab 202048, final_logit_softcapping 20.0; the odd vocab pads the last shard.
+VOCABS = [202048, 200019]
+SOFTCAP = 20.0
+
+
+def _shards(full, vocab):
+    shard = full.shape[1] // WORLD
+    return [full[:, r * shard : (r + 1) * shard].contiguous() for r in range(WORLD)]
+
+
+def _reference(shards, vocab):
+    gathered = torch.stack(shards)
+    out = torch.empty((shards[0].shape[0], vocab), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    return gathered_softcap_logits(gathered, SOFTCAP, out)
+
+
+def _sharded_argmax(shards, vocab):
+    shard = shards[0].shape[1]
+    local = [
+        softcap_row_argmax(
+            shards[r], SOFTCAP, max(0, min(shard, vocab - r * shard)), r * shard
+        )
+        for r in range(WORLD)
+    ]
+    return merge_row_argmax_shards(torch.stack(local))
+
+
+def _logits_with_ties(rows, vocab, seed):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    padded = ((vocab + 63) // 64) * 64
+    shard = padded // WORLD
+    full = torch.randn(rows, padded, device="cuda") * 8
+    # Padded columns hold the largest value and must be ignored.
+    full[:, vocab:] = 1e6
+    top = full[:, :vocab].amax(dim=1)
+    # Row 0: exact tie across shards 0 and 3; row 1: tie inside shard 1.
+    full[0, 7] = full[0, 3 * shard + 11] = top[0] + 1
+    full[1, shard + 5] = full[1, shard + 9] = top[1] + 1
+    # Row 2: raw values past the softcap saturation tie after tanh; the lower index wins
+    # even though its raw value is smaller.
+    full[2, shard + 1] = 5000.0
+    full[2, 2 * shard + 1] = 9000.0
+    # Row 3: all equal -> index 0; row 4: one finite value among -inf.
+    full[3, :vocab] = 1.5
+    full[4, :vocab] = float("-inf")
+    full[4, 2 * shard + 3] = -3.0
+    # Row 5: the global max sits in the last valid column.
+    full[5, vocab - 1] = top[5] + 1
+    return full
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("vocab", VOCABS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [7, 64, 128])
+def test_sharded_argmax_matches_gathered(vocab, rows):
+    full = _logits_with_ties(rows, vocab, seed=rows)
+    shards = _shards(full, vocab)
+    ref = torch.argmax(_reference(shards, vocab), dim=-1)
+    got = _sharded_argmax(shards, vocab)
+    assert torch.equal(got, ref)
+    expect = {0: 7, 1: shards[0].shape[1] + 5, 2: shards[0].shape[1] + 1, 3: 0}
+    expect[4] = 2 * shards[0].shape[1] + 3
+    expect[5] = vocab - 1
+    for row, col in expect.items():
+        assert int(got[row]) == col, (row, int(got[row]), col)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("vocab", VOCABS)
+def test_gathered_bonus_rows_match_full_gather(vocab):
+    bs, stride = 8, 8
+    full = _logits_with_ties(bs * stride, vocab, seed=1)
+    shards = _shards(full, vocab)
+    ref = _reference(shards, vocab)
+    correct_len = torch.randint(0, stride, (bs,), device="cuda")
+    row_index = torch.arange(bs, device="cuda") * stride + correct_len
+    local = [s.index_select(0, row_index) for s in shards]
+    out = torch.empty((bs, vocab), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    rows = gathered_softcap_logits(torch.stack(local), SOFTCAP, out)
+    assert torch.equal(rows, ref.index_select(0, row_index))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        rows, SOFTCAP * torch.tanh(full[row_index, :vocab] / SOFTCAP)
+    )
+
+
+def test_simulated_bonus_on_gathered_rows():
+    # One gathered row per request (rows_per_request=1, correct_len=0): a dominant
+    # logit at near-zero temperature must come back as that request's bonus.
+    bs, vocab = 8, VOCABS[0]
+    torch.manual_seed(3)
+    rows = torch.randn(bs, vocab, device="cuda")
+    winner = torch.randint(0, vocab, (bs,), device="cuda")
+    rows[torch.arange(bs, device="cuda"), winner] += 100.0
+    bonus = simulated_bonus_sample(
+        target_logits=rows,
+        correct_len=torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        temperatures=torch.full((bs,), 1e-5, device="cuda"),
+        bs=bs,
+        rows_per_request=1,
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(bonus, winner)

+"""A compact-window DFLASH draft pool on the target's sliding-window ids
+(SGLANG_ENABLE_DFLASH_SWA_DRAFT_KV): the draft runner's write ids are the
+target's SWA translation, under the target's own SWA space key, and the
+target allocators without a paged full->SWA map are refused.
+
+CPU-only.
+"""
+
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import publish, reset_context
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.alloc.id_space import IdSpace, IdSpaceKind
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.alloc.runner_ids import RunnerIds
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+def _target(full_to_swa, **overrides):
+    pool = SimpleNamespace()
+    swa_space = IdSpace(
+        key=(IdSpaceKind.SLIDING_WINDOW, id(pool)),
+        write=lambda ids: full_to_swa[ids.to(torch.int64)],
+    )
+    pool.id_spaces = lambda: {
+        IdSpaceKind.FULL: IdSpace(key=(IdSpaceKind.FULL, id(pool))),
+        IdSpaceKind.SLIDING_WINDOW: swa_space,
+    }
+    fields = dict(
+        has_window_pool=True,
+        hands_out_virtual_ids=False,
+        swa_req_ring=False,
+        get_kvcache=lambda: pool,
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**fields), swa_space
+
+
+def _runner(allocator, pool):
+    return RunnerIds(
+        req_to_token=torch.zeros((4, 16), dtype=torch.int32),
+        token_to_kv_pool_allocator=allocator,
+        token_to_kv_pool=pool,
+        page_size=1,
+        device="cpu",
+        is_draft_worker=True,
+    )
+
+
+class TestDFlashSWADraftKVIds(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        reset_context()
+        publish(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"), role="tokenizer")
+
+    def test_draft_writes_target_swa_ids(self):
+        full_to_swa = torch.arange(64, dtype=torch.int64) * 3 + 1
+        allocator, swa_space = _target(full_to_swa)
+        draft = _runner(allocator, SimpleNamespace(follows_target_swa_ids=True))
+        space = draft.space(IdSpaceKind.FULL)
+        self.assertEqual(space.key, swa_space.key)
+        self.assertIsNone(draft.space(IdSpaceKind.SLIDING_WINDOW))
+        loc = torch.tensor([5, 9, 30])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(space.write(loc), full_to_swa[loc])
+
+    def test_plain_draft_keeps_its_own_ids(self):
+        allocator, _ = _target(torch.arange(8))
+        own = {IdSpaceKind.FULL: IdSpace(key=(IdSpaceKind.FULL, None))}
+        draft = _runner(allocator, SimpleNamespace(id_spaces=lambda: own))
+        self.assertIs(draft.space(IdSpaceKind.FULL), own[IdSpaceKind.FULL])
+
+    def test_refuses_targets_without_paged_map(self):
+        draft_pool = SimpleNamespace(follows_target_swa_ids=True)
+        for overrides in (
+            {"has_window_pool": False},
+            {"swa_req_ring": True},
+        ):
+            allocator, _ = _target(torch.arange(8), **overrides)
+            with self.subTest(**overrides), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                _runner(allocator, draft_pool)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
